chapters.title: The West Sonoma Coast today
chapters.body: The West Sonoma Coast AVA lies in Sonoma County, within the Sonoma Coast and North Coast AVAs; the UC Davis AVA Project lists it as established on 23 May 2022. Fort Ross-Seaview is nested in it, and Dry Creek Valley and Green Valley of Russian River Valley also lie inside this frame. The frame runs from the Pacific shore inland; its highest ground, about 1,055 m, is at its north-east corner. Traces of two faults from the USGS UCERF3 fault model enter the frame, both right-lateral: the San Andreas (North Coast) and Rodgers Creek–Healdsburg faults. The gold lines are the AVA boundaries.
